evidence: NOTE: palimnex.tests.test_retrieval_shadow 9/9 passed, including 96 pinned temporary-corpus golden combinations. Contract validator status valid.

NOTE: Independent BASELINE IDENTITY: git archive HEAD palimnex extracted to /tmp/palimnex-phase3-review/head and imported beside the working tree. retrieve_sources matched on 246/246 queries and settings (limits, byte budgets, include_graph true/false, empty and no-match queries). mismatch_count 0.

NOTE: retrieve_sources calls _rank_channels, _fuse_rankings, and _retrieval_result only. ontology_channel is invoked only from shadow_retrieve. grep of palimnex/*.py: shadow_retrieve is imported by palimnex/ontology_eval.py and by tests.

NOTE: Fusion parity: RRF_K remains 60; ontology ranking is capped at 512 before fusion; budget_items and [:limit] apply to both baseline and shadow. Null-registry shadow baseline JSON equals retrieve_sources. Candidate registry refused as registry_kind_mismatch with no shadow result. All four channel names appear in comparison.channels.

NOTE: Frozen ONT-SEC-002 raises ConceptRegistryError source_privacy_refused, does not echo the canary, and does not call build_shadow_comparison. Frozen ONT-CAND-002 does not mark the approved concept ambiguous. Ambiguous, stale, and uncovered concepts leave the shadow ranking identical to baseline.

NOTE: palimnex/retrieval.py now imports palimnex.ontology_shadow at module level. retrieve_sources output identity holds; rollback of the shadow channel must revert this import together with retrieval.py.
commands: ./.venv/bin/python -m unittest palimnex.tests.test_retrieval_shadow palimnex.tests.test_ontology_shadow palimnex.tests.test_coverage palimnex.tests.test_explain_search palimnex.tests.test_coverage_frozen -v
source_grounding_result: Shadow fusion reuses the same lexical, symbol, and graph rankings produced for retrieve_sources and appends (ontology, channel.ranking). Baseline in the shadow_retrieve return is the retrieve_sources document for the same arguments. Independent HEAD-versus-working comparison found no byte difference.
privacy_result: Secret bound sources refuse on the verify_source_bindings path before comparison construction. Candidate registries refuse before fusion. Query privacy is enforced inside ontology_channel/build_shadow_comparison. No secret value is echoed.
retrieval_quality_result: Shadow uses the same RRF_K, pointer tie-break, 512 candidate cap, budget_items, and limit as baseline. Ontology can admit a bound chunk into the shadow ranking while the returned baseline stays unchanged. Channel ranks for lexical, symbol, graph, and ontology remain visible on shadow items.
compatibility_result: Adds public palimnex.retrieval.shadow_retrieve with the keyword-only contract. retrieve_sources signature, validation, errors, ranking, budgeting, and result fields stay the same. search, context, and explain-search still consume retrieve_sources and do not call shadow_retrieve.
rollback_result: Revert palimnex/retrieval.py and delete palimnex/tests/test_retrieval_shadow.py together with the channel module it imports. HEAD retrieve_sources behavior is the rollback target and was byte-identical in this review.
authority_result: No configuration key enables retrieval influence. shadow_retrieve is an evidence API for evaluation. retrieve_sources remains the production ranking.
limitations: Cache-backed core.search was not live-compared; cache_v3.py is unmodified and search does not import retrieval.py.
